decisions.reason: Disabling the card selector until implementation does not alter the deferred Fiat Card On-Ramp's intended provider, flow, or eventual behavior; implementation status must not be propagated.
The source leaves USDC selectable and does not change the required USDC wallet mint behavior.
The complaint that ETH cannot be selected concerns payment-method selection UI; it does not modify the independently defined ETH mint and conversion behavior.
The source does not change when mint-success feedback should appear.
Card-option availability is independent of optional tipping.
Disabling an unimplemented card option does not change the asset that successful mints must deliver.
The payment-selector change does not alter mint price or revenue allocation.
The source instructs that an unimplemented card option be disabled but does not direct a change to the FAQ's description of the intended future Transak flow.
Payment-method availability does not affect prize winner selection.
The source does not change certificate or confirmation-email behavior.
Disabling the card selector does not change the NFT mint number's use as a referral code or its display locations.
The source does not change no-code reward allocation rules.
